title: ErrorEnvelope
description:
The stable error response shared by typed UI/IPC boundaries.

Error-code-specific detail keys remain governed by the frozen error catalog.
This transport type deliberately does not invent a second error-code enum.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code from the frozen error catalog.

correlation_id.description: Canonical UUIDv7 used to correlate diagnostics.

details.description: Whitelisted, redacted details defined per error code.

field.description: Stable field path for validation errors; otherwise `null`.

message.description: Localizable, human-readable message with no secrets or backtraces.

retryable.description: Whether the same idempotent intent may be retried after remediation.
